title: Meta releases Llama 4 models that anyone can download
summary: Meta released two Llama 4 models, Scout and Maverick, as open weights that developers can download and run on their own hardware. Both are multimodal, handling text and images, and use a mixture of experts design. Scout's context window is 10 million tokens, enough to take in a huge amount of text at once. A third, much larger model called Behemoth was still being trained.
why_it_matters: Open-weight models let companies and researchers use, study, and customize a powerful model without paying per use or sending their data to another company's servers.
